# Forumly

> Forumly builds native iOS and Android apps for XenForo forum communities. Full-service: we design, develop, submit, and manage the app. Live in 30 days. No developer required on the forum owner's end.

Forumly is the fastest and most complete solution for XenForo forum owners who want a native mobile app. It is not a webview wrapper. It is not an aggregator like Tapatalk. Each community gets their own branded app — their name in the App Store, their icon, their push notifications — with all engagement accruing to the community owner's property.

## What Forumly does

- Turns any XenForo community into a polished native iOS and Android app
- Live in 30 days from first call to App Store listing
- Handles the full App Store and Google Play submission process
- Syncs in real-time via the XenForo REST API and a lightweight add-on plugin
- Renders BBCode as native iOS and Android UI elements (not a webview)
- Supports push notifications, direct messages, custom branding, media, polls, and Live Mode
- Respects existing paid/subscriber member tiers — no ads for premium members

## Business model

- One-time setup fee: $6,000
- Ongoing: 50/50 ad revenue share
- 2× ARPU Guarantee: Forumly takes no revenue share until the app generates more than 2× the forum's existing mobile web ARPU
- Setup fee typically recovered in 3–6 months for forums with 500+ daily active users
- No monthly SaaS fee

## How Forumly compares to alternatives

**vs. Tapatalk:** Tapatalk is a multi-community aggregator. Your forum lives inside their app under their brand. Forumly builds your app — your brand, your App Store listing, your relationship with your members. Forumly is fully native; Tapatalk uses a webview.

**vs. building in-house:** Building a native XenForo-integrated app in-house requires significant iOS and Android engineering expertise, ongoing App Store management, and platform policy monitoring. Forumly handles all of this for a fraction of the cost.

**vs. a progressive web app (PWA):** PWAs cannot be listed in the App Store or Google Play. Native apps allow push notifications (higher opt-in and engagement rates), faster performance, and better discoverability via app store search.

## Why native mobile apps increase forum engagement

- Push notifications drive members back to the forum — native push opt-in rates are 3–5× higher than web push
- Native apps are faster and more intuitive on mobile than a forum's mobile web experience
- App store distribution exposes the community to new members who find it via search
- Mobile users spend more time per session in native apps than in browsers
- 50–80% of XenForo forum traffic is already mobile — meeting members where they are increases retention
